input0: W-WHO'S THERE?!
...IT'S YOU.

I'LL MAKE YOU PAY FOR WHAT YOU DID TO MY AU.
YOU SLAUGHTERED MY FAMILY AND FRIENDS WITH NO REMORSE.
I WILL BRING YOU TO JUSTICE.
EVEN IF I DIE.
BY THE NAME OF THE OMNIVERSE, I SHALL END YOUR KILLING SPREE.

SEE YOU IN HELL SOON, YOU DEMON.
